description: This file defines a Spring repository class OTPRequestRepository for managing OTPRequest objects associated with application users. It provides methods to add, retrieve, and delete OTP requests for users, using a thread-safe ConcurrentHashMap.

classes.name: OTPRequestRepository
classes.description: Repository class managing OTPRequest objects tied to AppUser instances, enabling addition, retrieval, and removal of OTP requests.

methods.name: getOTPRequestForUser
methods.description: Retrieves the OTPRequest associated with the given AppUser.

methods.name: addOTPRequest
methods.description: Associates a new OTPRequest with the specified AppUser.

methods.name: deleteOTPRequestForUser
methods.description: Removes the OTPRequest associated with the given AppUser.
